Name: Eemie's Birds
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I finally heard back from Eemiestardew and got permission to update their animals to 1.6 so here they are!

This mod brings Eemie's cardinals and toucans to Stardew Valley! They live in coops and produce mixed seeds and bread.

Credit for the original mod goes to Eemiestardew and minervamaga and can be found [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/688256-eemies-animals-for-bfav]here[/url]

Enjoy!
